steps.en: Install RQ and run a trusted Redis or Valkey server
steps.zh: 安装 RQ，运行可信的 Redis 或 Valkey

steps.en: Connect a queue and enqueue an importable Python function
steps.zh: 连接队列，把可导入的 Python 函数入队

steps.en: Serializes the call into Redis and returns a Job proxy
steps.zh: 把调用序列化进 Redis，并返回 Job 代理

steps.en: Start and supervise workers for the queues they should serve
steps.zh: 启动并托管负责这些队列的 worker

steps.en: Fetches, executes, and records each job's status and result
steps.zh: 拉取并执行作业，记录状态与结果

value.en: Blocking Python work leaves the request path without adding a general-purpose message broker
value.zh: 阻塞的 Python 工作离开请求路径，无需引入通用消息 broker
